hypotheses.reasoning: notif-worker crashes every time on the same message msg-453808 at offset 495220 (RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded in expandReferences — likely a self-referential/cyclic template reference). The offset is never committed, so each restart resumes at 495220 and crashes again, which causes the CrashLoopBackOff with growing backoff. The consumer lag that notification-svc reports (1.6k rising to 19k) is the downstream effect. No other service logged errors.

v4.20.8 rolled out about 1.5 minutes before the first crash. However, it processed batches successfully after the rollout (#222, #233), and the same crash repeats on instances that report v3.4.1 (#239, #245). That points to the message, not the build.

verdict.recommendedAction: Move msg-453808 (offset 495220) on notifications.outbound to a dead-letter queue, or skip it, so the worker can make progress and drain the lag. Then fix expandReferences to detect cycles and limit recursion depth, and catch per-message exceptions so one bad message goes to the DLQ instead of crashing the process. Also check why the restarted pods report v3.4.1.
